title: Karnataka High Court Quashes Rs 482.69 Crore Mining Penalty Against Adani Group's ACC Limited
case_name: ACC Limited v. State of Karnataka & Ors.
card_summary: A Division Bench of the Karnataka High Court quashed a Rs 482.69 crore mining penalty on ACC Limited over limestone mining in Kalaburagi. It held the lease stood automatically extended under Section 8A(5) of the MMDR Act, so a missing supplementary lease deed did not make the mining unlawful, and upheld a central order rejecting the state's notional ratio for computing royalty.
card_tip: A missing supplementary lease deed is not fatal where a lease already stands deemed-extended by statute, and royalty assessed on a notional conversion ratio rather than actual weighment invites challenge.
verification_notes: Confirmed by Bar and Bench, LiveLaw and LiveLawBiz; all three agree on the penalty figure, the deemed-extension finding under Section 8A(5), and the rejection of the state's notional 1:1.42 limestone-to-clinker ratio. Reports differ on the exact refund amount the state was directed to pay back, so that figure is omitted from the card.
